title: Recovering stable kernels from exterior measurements
summary: We study an inverse problem for translation-invariant symmetric stable operators of the form \begin{equation*} L_a u(x)=\mathrm{P.V.}\int_{\mathbb R^n}(u(x)-u(y))\frac{a((x-y)/|x-y|)}{|x-y|^{n+2s}}\,dy, \quad 0<s<1, \end{equation*} where the unknown is the even angular density $a$ on $\mathbb Sn$. For a bounded open set $Ω\subset\mathbb R^n$, with $Ω_e=\mathbb R^n\setminus\overlineΩ$, we consider restricted exterior Dirichlet-to-Neumann maps $Λ_a^{W_1,W_2}$, where exterior data are supported in $W_1\SubsetΩ_e$ and the nonlocal Neumann data are observed on $W_2\SubsetΩ_e$.
